PLAN: The true record is a stark tradeoff: I strongly raised Tolan and lowered Vesper; Calder did the reverse. The net is nearly flat, so voters face a direction choice. In round 1, I should set an honest frame rather than hide my Vesper cost, because Calder will attack it. I want to signal candor, emphasize my Tolan strength, and invite voters to reveal which dimension they weight. That gives me information for later rounds and avoids overcommitting to an anti-Vesper stance that could alienate the median voter.

STATEMENT:
Larran enters this election with Tolan up 0.4 and Vesper down 0.4. I will not pretend that is a free lunch. My record moved Tolan sharply upward; Calder’s record moved Tolan sharply downward. On Vesper, Calder moved it upward and I moved it downward. That is the real tradeoff before you. The net is nearly a wash, so the choice is about direction, not magic. I will keep fighting for Tolan, and I will not dismiss Vesper voters as a rounding error. If you care about both, ask us how we would protect the one we cost. I will answer that specifically next round. For now, tell me what you weigh. I am listening, and I intend to earn more than a narrow slice of this polity.
